parameter_refs.name: independent_check_event
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: original driver-input check event observed or absent

quote: If a highway has two or more clearly marked lanes for traffic traveling in one direction, vehicles must: Not be moved from that lane until the driver has given the appropriate turn signal and ascertained that such movement can be made with safety.

activation.condition: Highway has at least two clearly marked lanes for traffic in one direction; driver controls a vehicle in a source lane.

judgment_calls_needed.note: No numeric legal lead-time cutoff is supplied.
An observed check event and traffic state do not establish cognition or safety.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: ascertained that such movement can be made with safety

obligation.description: Do not move from the lane until appropriate signal has been given and driver has ascertained that movement can be made with safety.

timing.description: Join signal readback and separate driver-input event to original lane movement onset by Native frame and time.
